note: Hewitt, TX -- the eleven base districts for which the Zoning Ordinance states a numeric dimensional block, read from Appendix A (ZONING) of the Hewitt Code of Ordinances on Municode. ROUTE: the Municode Appendix A page at the citation_url returned full server-rendered ordinance text to a plain fetch on this pass (the same URL shape the batch-1 post-mortem warns can be a JavaScript shell for other cities) -- no browser render was needed for Hewitt and the read is reproducible by re-fetching that URL. A Zoneomics mirror of the same ordinance (.../hewitt-TX/chapter_2 = Sections 2.x, .../hewitt-TX/chapter_6 = Section 6.101) was used only as a cross-check on the R-1/R-1-G split and on the §6.101 yard clause; every value coded here comes from the Municode text. VINTAGE: the yard and height sections carry '(Ord. No. 11-15-99, 11-15-99)' at their foot, and Section 7.101 (lot area and maximum coverage) carries '(Ord. No. 11-15-99, 11-15-99; Ord. No. 2006-04-03, Sec. 11, 4-3-06)'. So the dimensional provisions as read were last amended 4-3-06 and date to a base ordinance of 11-15-99. The codified Appendix A itself carries no single effective date on the page, and no adoption date is asserted here beyond those amendment stamps read at source. NOT THE SOURCE OF ANY VALUE: Table I in Part 16 ('TABLES') of the same Appendix prints a one-page summary of height/side/rear/front/coverage by district, but it says of itself 'This chart is not part of the zoning ordinance. Refer to the full text for complete requirements.' No value in this table is taken from it; every figure is taken from the operative section quoted in its own provenance. Where Table I and the ordinance text disagree in shape (Table I omits R-1-G entirely), the text governs here. OMITTED AND WHY: (1) MH manufactured home park -- Section 2.107 regulates the park as a whole (minimum park size 3 acres, width/depth 250 ft, maximum coverage 30% of park area, height 35 ft) and states yard figures only for individual spaces in existing nonconforming parks (Section 2.107.1: five feet on all sides). There is no lot-level front/side/rear block for the district, so coding one would be invention. (2) P-R planned residential, P-C planned commercial, M-P planned industrial and BP business park -- planned/overlay-style districts whose standards are set with the approving plan rather than in a Euclidian block; Section 2.115 ('Special regulations are made for the planned districts') defers them. (3) C-2, C-O and M are INCLUDED, but note that their yard standards are stated as 'no side or rear yard minimums shall be required' (C-2), 'no rear yard minimums shall be required' (C-O) and 'no minimum yard requirements ... except that where a lot abuts a lot in an R district, the side or rear yard required in that R district must be provided along the boundary line' (M) -- so their coded 0 means 'no yard required', which is a real standard, not a gap. M's residential-adjacency condition is preserved verbatim in the quote and is NOT collapsed into the 0. NO IMPERVIOUS STANDARD EXISTS in this ordinance (full-text search, cited per field); the coverage column is 'maximum lot coverage ... covered by buildings' only, and C-2/C-O/M state no coverage cap at all (Section 7.101(G): 'there are no minimum lot dimensions or maximum lot coverage for the C-2, C-O or M districts'). R-1-G's coverage is likewise not stated: Section 2.101.1(F) is headed 'Maximum lot coverage' but its only content is a minimum living-area figure (1,750 sq ft), an apparent drafting defect -- coded not_specified with the heading and text quoted. C-OD's corner-lot side yard is not stated in Section 2.108(C)(3) (front and rear 25 ft, side yards at least 10 ft, no corner clause) and is coded not_specified rather than mirrored. R-1-G's dimensional block comes from Section 2.101.1, a separate section that Hewitt's own Table I omits; its height is stated as 'Maximum two stories or 37 feet six inches', coded 37.5 ft.
